name: Apollo.io
description: Apollo.io is a sales intelligence and engagement platform that combines a B2B contact and company database with email/call sequencing, a built-in dialer, and AI-assisted prospecting tools in a single credit-based subscription.
best_for: Sales teams that want prospect data, multichannel outreach sequences, and a dialer in one platform instead of stitching together separate data and engagement tools.
features: Verified B2B contact and company database accessed via a credit system (1 credit per email, 8 credits per phone number)
Outbound email/call sequences, with unlimited sequences and A/Z testing on paid plans
Built-in US dialer with call recording, plus an international dialer and parallel/power dialer as paid add-ons
AI Assistant, AI Research, and AI-based lead scoring built into every plan
Chrome, Gmail, and Salesforce browser extensions for in-context prospecting
Buying-intent topics and website visitor identification (company- and contact-level)
Waterfall enrichment plus CSV, CRM, and API data enrichment with automated workflows
Deal/pipeline management, meeting scheduling, and inbound lead routing

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 900 credits per seat per year (granted monthly, ~75/month). Includes AI Assistant (5-chat limit), 2 sequences, basic filters, website visitor ID (20 companies/month), and call recording (150 minutes).

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: $65/seat/month if billed monthly. 30,000 credits per seat per year, granted upfront. Adds unlimited sequences, advanced filters, waterfall enrichment, and a 14-day free trial.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Marked "Most Popular" on the pricing page. $99/seat/month if billed monthly. 48,000 credits per seat per year. Adds unlimited meeting events, agentic loops, call recording/AI insights (4,000 minutes), and analytics.

tiers.name: Organization
tiers.notes: Minimum 3 seats, billed annually. 72,000 credits per seat per year. Adds SSO, advanced security configurations, and a "Talk to Sales" primary call-to-action despite the published price.

pros: Publishes exact self-serve per-seat pricing for all four tiers, including the top "Organization" tier, rather than gating everything behind a sales call
Free plan includes real usage (900 credits/year, 2 sequences, a dialer with 150 call-recording minutes) rather than only a time-limited trial
Combines contact data, email/dialer sequencing, and browser extensions for Chrome, Gmail, and Salesforce in one subscription
States ISO 27001 certification, a SOC 2 report (via A-LIGN), and GDPR compliance as both a data processor and controller
cons: Feature access is metered by a credit system on top of the seat price, so heavy use of phone-number reveals (8 credits each) or enrichment can exhaust monthly/annual allowances
Non-Gmail/Microsoft email accounts cannot be connected for sending until you're on a paid plan
The Organization tier requires a minimum of 3 seats

faq.question: Does Apollo.io have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Apollo's Free plan is $0 per seat and includes 900 credits per seat per year (granted monthly), 2 sequences, basic filters, and 150 minutes of call recording, according to its pricing page.

faq.question: How much does Apollo.io cost?
faq.answer: As of the pricing page's annual-billing view, Basic is $49/seat/month, Professional is $79/seat/month, and Organization is $119/seat/month (minimum 3 seats). Monthly billing is higher ($65 and $99 for Basic and Professional respectively).

faq.question: Does Apollo.io offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Basic and Professional plans show a "Start 14-day trial" option on the pricing page. The Free plan itself has no time limit.

faq.question: Is Apollo.io GDPR compliant?
faq.answer: Apollo's security page states it is GDPR compliant as both a data processor and a data controller, and that it is ISO 27001 certified with a SOC 2 report available from A-LIGN.
